settings.question: How can I get more details about an item?
settings.answer: Check Item Description on the product page for the listing details. For measurements, condition questions, or help with sizing, contact Sole Paradise before ordering.

settings.question: How is authenticity checked?
settings.answer: Every piece is individually inspected by Sole Paradise before it is listed. We stand behind the authenticity of every item we sell.

settings.question: Which shipping options are available?
settings.answer: UPS Next Day Air and UPS Ground are available for eligible orders. Shipping options and rates for your address appear at checkout.

settings.question: Can I arrange pickup or same-day delivery?
settings.answer: Contact the shop to confirm Chicago pickup or same-day delivery availability and coordinate a time.

settings.question: Which payment methods can I use?
settings.answer: The payment methods enabled for the store are shown in the footer. Available payment options for your order appear at checkout.
